sources.scope: Site::QwenworkIntl only: fixed international origin, device PKCE parameters, account identity, renewal, complete Qwenwork COSY identity, qwork catalog, chat protocol and account context
sources.changes: Ported into an isolated wasm32-unknown-unknown provider. Network, entropy, time, locks and state use controlled host services. No filesystem, environment, process, native-helper, PAT, job-token, UMID or campaign implementation is included. International wallet requests are deliberately absent because the native baseline has no evidence for them.
sources.evidence: The native endpoints module attributes the international origin, client_id and redirect_uri to EchoBird and records device-entry checks with a hyphenated UUID nonce. This is not a verified end-to-end international login or chat result.
sources.limitations: International COSY client fields, token lifecycle, catalog and account-context shapes are native baseline inferences from the same product's China implementation, not independently verified international behavior. Native comments cite dumate2api without a pinned revision; no such revision is fabricated.

sources.scope: Locally copied protocol algorithms and reviewed controlled-host account, login, model and chat patterns
sources.changes: Ordinary local source copies, not path dependencies or cross-directory includes. International provider, origin, PKCE parameters, labels and state namespaces are independent. China wallet code, domestic machine-file suggestions and domestic activity assumptions are not carried into this package.

sources.source: EchoBird qwenwork_accounts, as attributed by the native endpoints.rs
sources.scope: International gateway, client_id and redirect_uri protocol facts
sources.limitation: The native attribution does not record an exact EchoBird revision for these constants. The existing full notice is retained; no new repository revision or source-code import is asserted.

sources.purpose: Reviewed the independently declared QwenWork International gateway/client/redirect, optional PKCE result echoes, standard expires_in seconds, nested schema-2 user/device credentials, and fixed client/redirect refresh parameters. The existing international gateway and protocol family remain unchanged.
sources.limitations: No live international account verification. Enterprise target/team handling and local client credential reading are not implemented by this provider; China wallet endpoints and local-file writes were not copied. Unknown renewal results retain a credential-bound persistent guard instead of replaying the old material.

sources.purpose: Reviewed device-poll pending forms and conditional nonce/challenge validation, direct/nested OpenAI stream envelopes, control heartbeats, final unterminated SSE data and completion without a DONE sentinel. The international package keeps its own endpoint, parameters, account namespaces and model entitlements.

sources.limitations: This reference is a China deployment and does not establish international API availability; only shape compatibility and completion safety were reviewed. No provider origins, account pools, machine files or forced system prompt were copied. No source code was copied from this reference.

dependencies.note: AES/CBC/RSA use maintained RustCrypto crates with host-seeded ChaCha20, not custom cryptographic primitives, native executables or operating-system entropy. Dependency notices remain subject to the package collector.
